Save a permitted direct MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, WAV, OGG, OPUS or WebM audio file for offline listening. A direct HTTPS link is required.
Ready. Downloads remain in NightWave\'s private Offline Library.

YouTube watch links, streaming manifests and protected media are not direct audio downloads. NightWave does not convert YouTube videos to MP3. Use Save in background to keep downloading after closing this screen. The foreground download stops when you leave. Original audio format is preserved. Temporary network errors are retried, but unsupported audio is never saved. Audio is deleted if NightWave is uninstalled.
